content: Brazilian personal finance app landscape 2026: Mobills (income/expense tracking, monthly planning, financial goals, Open Finance integration, PRO WhatsApp AI assistant, R$ 99.90/year), Organizze (manual control, simple reports, 7-day trial only, no free tier, basic goals), GuiaBolso (discontinued Nov 2022, acquired by PicPay). No major Brazilian app specifically targets dual-account household+business separation or Simples Nacional tracking. Weekly budget tracking not a standard feature in any of these apps - they focus on monthly.
